rules: This contract defines the method-selection gate only; it does not select a method.
Reference statistics cannot create a normalization candidate without a versioned selected_for_research_candidate decision.
Supported method names are implementation-supported research families, not a conclusion that any method is empirically preferred.
Percentiles, thresholds, Archetype boundaries, and Production activation remain unauthorized.
The holdout split must remain excluded from method fitting and reference-statistics estimation.
A selected_for_research_candidate decision must be linked to a descriptive comparison packet and exact reference-split fingerprint.
Method selection must be an explicit versioned research decision; the comparison packet cannot auto-select or rank a winner.
The locked holdout split must not be used to select the center/scale method.
